description: Flip-flop octaver that generates signals one and two octaves below the input and mixes them back in, added or multiplied, keeping the unstable behaviour of the circuit it came from

params.text: Balances the original signal against the processed one
Balances the octave-down signal against the two-octaves-down signal, equal at the centre
Sets how the octave-down signal is mixed: added counter-clockwise, multiplied clockwise for an AM sound
Sets how the two-octaves-down signal is mixed: added counter-clockwise, multiplied clockwise for an AM sound
Attenuates and inverts the BLEND input before it is added to the BLEND knob
Attenuates and inverts the OCTAVE input before it is added to the OCTAVE knob
Attenuates and inverts the OCT-1 input before it is added to the OCT-1 knob
Attenuates and inverts the OCT-2 input before it is added to the OCT-2 knob

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input, and when it is the only one patched the processed signal is sent to both outputs
The right channel of the audio input, and when it is the only one patched the processed signal is sent to both outputs
A control voltage added to the BLEND setting, scaled by the BLEND attenuverter
A control voltage added to the OCTAVE setting, scaled by the OCTAVE attenuverter
A control voltage added to the OCT-1 setting, scaled by the OCT-1 attenuverter
A control voltage added to the OCT-2 setting, scaled by the OCT-2 attenuverter

outputs.text: The left channel of the processed signal
The right channel of the processed signal
